points.quote: Each service has an interface named `IFooService`. Next to it is a same-named constant: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')` (`instantiation.ts:109`).
A consumer declares the service as a constructor parameter, using the identifier as a decorator: ... `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService`

Classes are created with `instantiationService.createInstance(FooClass, ...staticArgs)`. It looks up each decorated parameter and builds the services on demand. ... Many consumers are themselves created through `createInstance`. Examples are workbench contributions registered with `registerWorkbenchContribution2`, and editor panes.
